title: Riley clone PageSpec
description: Generation-ready page composition for the Riley clone design-repo (pageSpecVersion 2.0.0). Every node is one section instance; closed type/template/motion/assetRole enums; additionalProperties:false everywhere. Required closed `page.mode` (clone | generation). `x-maxWords`, generation-mode leakage, token and retrieval rules are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py. URLs appear only as `href` on placeholder-url objects (.example/.invalid only); every other link is an assetRole the renderer resolves.

mode.description: clone = faithful reconstruction of this Riley clone (real Riley assets/copy allowed as evidence). generation = a new page for another brand built from this repo: no Riley identity, assets, people, claims, URLs or copy (GENERATION_MODE_* rules).

brand.description: Generation mode only: the fictional/operator brand the page is generated for (GENERATION_MODE_BRAND checks it is not Riley).

overlays.description: Global runtime overlays (retrievalEligible:false sections). Never page content; never allowed in nodes[] (RETRIEVAL_INELIGIBLE_NODE).

reducedMotionFallback.const: none-required: no section-level motion (primitive hover/press colour changes only).

style.description: Optional per-node token overrides. Values must be canonical token paths from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json (TOKEN_* rules in semantic_validate.py): no raw colours, no raw lengths, catalog fonts only, colour roles must exist in page.theme.
